name: Hilltone Software & Gases Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Hilltone Software and Gases Ltd is in the business of trading of Industrial and Medical Oxygen gases and other allied gases. It is also in the Software business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
HSGL manufactures and supplies Industrial and Medical Gases at its plant at Santej. It provides the entire range of industrial gases and medical gases like Nitrous Oxide - Bulk 'A' Type, Oxygen/ Nitrogen/ Co2/ D.A, Helium etc. Apart from this, company is also into software business

pros: Debtor days have improved from 80.3 to 53.4 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 41.0 days to 30.1 days
cons: Stock is trading at 5.85 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.84% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
